'''BobaofFett A classic ISB reborn''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[BobaofFett]]
* '''Published:''' 12 April 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' ISB Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS4 ISB BobaofFett DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Blaster Rack (V), Tarkin (V), Admiral Motti (V), Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V), The Empire's Back (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This is the Third deck of four. The first four I've made in nearly 3 years.

== Notes ==

* Posted '(ISB)Tarken(V)' dested Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 4), the latest original-era Tarkin (V) by this date (VS3 also existed); '(ISB)' marks ISB agents.
* Original-era (V): Blaster Rack (V) (VS1); Admiral Motti (V), Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V), The Empire's Back (V) (VS2); Tarkin (V) (VS4).
* Posted 'Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber' dested Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber (Reflections III); 'Colonel Wulf Yularen' Colonel Wullf Yularen; 'Prob Droid' Probe Droid.
* Unique locations posted x2 (Hoth, Hoth: Echo Corridor, Hoth: Defensive Perimeter) and Rebel Base Occupation x2 dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

the first thing you do is pull ECHO DOCKING BAY out with IMPERIAL ARREST ORDER. Try to flip the objective with in 2 to 3 turns (it can be done). spread out your agents on HOTH and drain like hell. Use PRESENCE OF THE FORCE on locations you need an icon and put EXPAND THE EMPIRE on the DEFENCEIVE PERIMETER. When draining with MAUL'S lightsaber lose a PROBE DROID so you can keep retiving it and bring it in to hand with PEITT. Keep your fleet at HOTH to keep REBEL BASE OCCUPATION going except The IMPERIAL-CALSS STAR DESTROYER, deploy that on CORUSCANT to drain there. Use MERREJK to pull out HOTH if your not drawing it. Last but not least DRAW LIKE HELL, and use REACTOR TRMINAL. If played right not only can this be a fast deck but you can drain up to 20+ force a turn.
